# pbs_datastore (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox Backup Server datastore configuration supporting directory, removable, and S3 backends.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique identifier for the datastore.

### Optional

- `backing_device` (String) UUID of the filesystem partition for a removable datastore (e.g., `01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef`).
- `comment` (String) Description for the datastore.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the datastore is disabled.
- `fingerprint` (String) Certificate fingerprint for secure connections (S3 datastores).
- `gc_schedule` (String) Garbage collection schedule in cron format (e.g., `daily`, `weekly`, or `0 3 * * 0`).
- `keep_daily` (Number) Number of daily backups to keep when pruning.
- `keep_hourly` (Number) Number of hourly backups to keep when pruning.
- `keep_last` (Number) Number of latest backups to keep when pruning.
- `keep_monthly` (Number) Number of monthly backups to keep when pruning.
- `keep_weekly` (Number) Number of weekly backups to keep when pruning.
- `keep_yearly` (Number) Number of yearly backups to keep when pruning.
- `maintenance_mode` (Attributes) Maintenance mode configuration allowing `offline` or `read-only` modes with optional message. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--maintenance_mode))
- `notification_mode` (String) Notification delivery mode. Valid values: `legacy-sendmail`, `notification-system`.
- `notify` (Attributes) Per-job notification settings overriding datastore defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notify))
- `notify_level` (String) Notification level. Valid values: `info`, `notice`, `warning`, `error`.
- `notify_user` (String) User to send datastore notifications to (e.g., `root@pam`).
- `overwrite_in_use` (Boolean) Allow overwriting chunks that are currently in use.
- `path` (String) Filesystem path to the datastore data. Required for directory datastores and used as the local cache directory for S3 datastores.
- `prune_schedule` (String, Deprecated) Prune schedule in cron format (e.g., `daily`, `weekly`, or `0 2 * * *`).
- `removable` (Boolean) Set to `true` to manage a removable datastore backed by a device UUID.
- `reuse_datastore` (Boolean) Reuse existing datastore chunks when possible.
- `s3_bucket` (String) S3 bucket name for S3 datastores. The bucket must be created beforehand.
- `s3_client` (String) S3 endpoint ID for S3 datastores. Must reference an existing S3 endpoint configuration.
- `tune_level` (Number, Deprecated) Tuning level for performance optimization (0-4).
- `tuning` (Attributes) Advanced tuning options for datastore behaviour such as chunk order and sync level. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tuning))
- `verify_new` (Boolean) Verify newly created snapshots immediately after backup.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) SHA-256 digest of the PBS configuration file (datastore.cfg) as of the last read. Informational only: it covers all objects in that file, changes on every write and is not used for locking.

<a id="nestedatt--maintenance_mode"></a>
### Nested Schema for `maintenance_mode`

Required:

- `type` (String) Maintenance mode type. Valid values: `offline`, `read-only`.

Optional:

- `message` (String) Optional message presented for maintenance mode.


<a id="nestedatt--notify"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notify`

Optional:

- `gc` (String) Garbage collection notification level. Valid values: `always`, `error`, `never`.
- `prune` (String) Prune job notification level. Valid values: `always`, `error`, `never`.
- `sync` (String) Sync job notification level. Valid values: `always`, `error`, `never`.
- `verify` (String) Verification job notification level. Valid values: `always`, `error`, `never`.


<a id="nestedatt--tuning"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tuning`

Optional:

- `chunk_order` (String) Chunk iteration order. Valid values: `inode`, `none`.
- `gc_atime_cutoff` (Number) Garbage collection access time cutoff in seconds.
- `gc_atime_safety_check` (Boolean) Enable garbage collection access time safety check.
- `gc_cache_capacity` (Number) Garbage collection cache capacity.
- `sync_level` (String) Datastore fsync level. Valid values: `none`, `filesystem`, `file`.
